# Diana

## Overview

- **Age:** 13  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed P4](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0004)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Family:** [Aunt Josephine](../character/aunt-josephine.md) (relative), [Miss Barry](../character/miss-barry.md) (relative)

## Appearance

Diana is described as a very pretty little girl with rosy cheeks. She has black eyes and glossy, jet-black hair.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VIII. Anne’s Bringing-up Is Begun P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P22](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0022), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P10](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0010), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. ## Personality

Diana is known for being both good and smart. She has also earned a reputation for her notable taste in dressing, leading others to frequently seek out her advice on fashion.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VIII. Anne’s Bringing-up Is Begun P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P9](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0009)_

## History

[Diana Barry](../character/di.md) formed a close friendship with [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), engaging in typical childhood games and establishing a story club together. Her mother briefly forbade Diana from playing with [Anne](../character/anne.md) after [Anne](../character/anne.md) accidentally served her currant wine instead of raspberry cordial, causing Diana to become ill. However, the friendship was restored after [Anne](../character/anne.md) helped save Diana's younger sister, [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md), when she fell gravely ill with croup. Later, Diana and [Anne](../character/anne.md) unwittingly jumped onto Diana's visiting great-aunt, [Aunt Josephine](../character/aunt-josephine.md), in a spare-room bed, though [Anne](../character/anne.md) managed to appease the angry woman and secure Diana's continued music lessons. Over the following years, Diana shared in various local activities with [Anne](../character/anne.md), including a [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) concert, an autumn trip to Aunt Josephine's estate in [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown) for the [Exhibition](../codex/places.md#exhibition), and local hotel performances. As their school years progressed, Diana supported [Anne](../character/anne.md) through her academic pursuits, bringing the news to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) that [Anne](../character/anne.md) had tied for first place on the [Island](../codex/places.md#island) on the Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) entrance examination, and later reuniting with [Anne](../character/anne.md) when she returned home after earning the Avery scholarship.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P32](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0032), [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P35](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0035), [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P37](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0037), [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P38](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0038), [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P39](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0039), [v1 CHAPTER II. ## Quotes

> “Yes,” said Diana, tossing her head, “but I’m sure he doesn’t like Julia Bell so very much. I’ve heard him say he studied the multiplication table by her freckles.”
>
> — Diana — [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P19](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0019)

> “Those Pye girls are cheats all round,” said Diana indignantly, as they climbed the fence of the main road. “Gertie Pye actually went and put her milk bottle in my place in the brook yesterday. Did you ever? I don’t speak to her now.”
>
> — Diana — [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P26](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0026)

> "Why, he makes fun of all the girls. He laughs at mine because it’s so black. He’s called me a crow a dozen times; and I never heard him apologize for anything before, either."
>
> — Diana — [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P53](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0053)

> "I do think you’re mean. What shall I do? Mr. Phillips will make me sit with that horrid Gertie Pye—I know he will because she is sitting alone. Do come back, Anne."
>
> — Diana — [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P74](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0074)

> “The nicest I ever drank,” said Diana. “It’s ever so much nicer than Mrs. Lynde’s, although she brags of hers so much. It doesn’t taste a bit like hers.”
>
> — Diana — [v1 CHAPTER XVI. Diana Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results P26](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0026)

## Relationships

### [Anne](../character/anne.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne--diana.md)

Diana and [Anne](../character/anne.md) are close, affectionate best friends and constant companions. Their friendship faces brief separations, such as when Mrs. [Barry](../character/barry.md) temporarily forbids them from playing together after [Anne](../character/anne.md) accidentally gets Diana drunk on currant wine, but they remain fiercely devoted to one another. They share imaginative games, study together, and support each other through childhood mishaps.

- Friend of — close and affectionate friends  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER VIII. Anne’s Bringing-up Is Begun P58](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0058), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P93](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0093), +19 more</sub>

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--diana.md)

Diana and [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) share a deeply affectionate bond as best chums and schoolmates. They spend their time playing, attending events like concerts, and forming imaginative clubs together. Their connection is strong enough that Diana eagerly brings [Anne](../character/anne.md) major news, such as Anne's exam results, and remains her primary confidante throughout their school years.

### [Aunt Josephine](../character/aunt-josephine.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/aunt-josephine--diana.md)

[Aunt Josephine](../character/aunt-josephine.md) is Diana's wealthy great-aunt. Though initially furious at Diana and [Anne](../character/anne.md) for accidentally jumping onto her bed during a late-night game, she is won over by Anne's honest apology. She subsequently sends gifts, such as kid slippers, and hosts both Diana and [Anne](../character/anne.md) for an extended visit to her estate, [Beechwood](../codex/places.md#beechwood), during the [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown) [Exhibition](../codex/places.md#exhibition).

- Relative of — aunt  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXV. Matthew Insists on Puffed Sleeves P42](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0042), [v1 CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed P23](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0023), [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P11](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0011), +1 more</sub>
